original_split.method: sklearn train_test_split over saved positional indices

valid_fasting_weight_filter.reason: CDC GLU_J codebook assigns zero weight when no fasting lab result exists or specimen did not meet the 8 to <24 hour fasting criterion; fasting-glucose results are retained for some nonfasted participants, but using them in the fasting analysis requires reweighting.

preprocessing_audit.threshold_selection_data: repeated stratified out-of-fold predictions from valid-weight training participants only

survey_weights.WTSAF2YR: eligibility filter and weighted prevalence context only; not passed as an ML sample_weight
survey_weights.SDMVSTRA_SDMVPSU: retained in Exp1 cohort file but not used in ordinary ML metrics or bootstrap; no design-based performance estimate
